post_clip.description: Sudden ignition and rapid fire eruption at a gas pump (frames 3–10), consistent with a fuel fire/explosion event—bright flash, intense flames engulfing the vehicle and pump area, no visible external ignition source or collision preceding it; this constitutes an incident anomaly (fire/explosion) and potential arson or accidental ignition.
